thread:
Maya S.: Quick check: users keep missing the token counter in the chat bubble. I'm proposing a compact persistent meter in the chat footer that shows live tokens + brief tooltip that expands per-message. Thoughts?
Ravi Patel: Agree. Prefer footer because it stays visible with long threads. Suggest format: 'Tokens • 87 (view)'. Clicking view toggles a per-message breakdown panel.
Joan K.: One more thing: for streaming we currently show a pulsing dot. Users asked for a clearer progress cue. Can we show a tiny progress percentage (estimated) next to the caret? Even 0-100% fuzzy estimate could reduce confusion.
Tomás V.: Backend note: estimating percent is tricky due to variable generation length. We could show 'progress: tokens streamed / estimated max' (e.g., 125/400) instead of percent. Less misleading.
Maya S.: That's fine. UX thought: show '125/400 tokens' inline and make the '400' dim. Also add a small keyboard hint 'Esc to stop' in microcopy.
Ravi Patel: Stop semantics convo: if user hits Stop we persist the partial content and record an event 'playground.stop.partial'. If they subsequently Regenerate, we start a fresh generation. This matches user expectations but we need clear copy: 'Stop — keep partial'.
Joan K.: Microcopy alternatives for testing: 1) 'Stop — save partial' 2) 'Stop (keeps partial reply)' 3) 'Halt generation — partial saved'. Which do we like for clarity?
ux-research: Quick data: in last 50 tests, 62% expected Regenerate to continue the stream, 38% expected a fresh run. So copy should nudge toward fresh run to avoid false expectations. Suggest option 2.
accessibility-bot: a11y check: ensure any progress/provisional updates use role="status" aria-live="polite" and we include a short summarizing announcement after stop (e.g., 'Generation stopped. Partial result saved.'). Also ensure the token meter is keyboard focusable and announces value when focused.
Tomás V.: For the prompt library: users requested keyboard nav (j/k or arrow keys) and enter to insert. We'll expose aria-activedescendant on the listbox and manage roving tabindex for cards. Also add aria-label: 'Insert prompt: <title>'.
Maya S.: Good. Also, tiny UI nit: regenerate button placement — some folks click it expecting to re-run the same prompt+settings. We might add a small badge that shows whether regenerate preserves system instructions and chat history. Tooltip copy: 'Regenerate reply — preserves conversation context'.
Ravi Patel: Analytics: add flags to events: regenerate_type=(preserve_context|fresh), stop_type=(partial|cancel). Will help measure confusion.
Joan K.: Contrast issue: the footer meter in the dark theme becomes almost invisible on small screens. UI-bot reports contrast 3.2:1. Must reach >=4.5:1 for 12px small text. Let's bump weight or change background.
accessibility-bot: Also for mobile: make tap target >=44px for token meter expand control.
Maya S.: Actionables: Joan will update mock with footer meter + inline token count in stream UI; Tomás will stub aria-live + listbox navigation; Ravi will add events to telemetry plan and draft microcopy variations; ux-research will schedule 5 moderated tests for the new wording. We'll reconvene in async thread.
Ravi Patel: I'll prototype a small CSS spec for the footer meter (sticky bottom, 32px height, condensed font).
Joan K.: Uploading mock v3 in figma link: https://rwdxd/figma/playground-meter-v3 (frames + mobile).
Maya S.: Thanks all — will collect microcopy A/B results by Friday. :sparkles:
